name: Keep long chats short with history compaction and recall search
description: A chat agent with session-based Chat Memory v2. A small turn window keeps only the last few turns in the prompt and a Claude Haiku model compacts older turns, while conversation search lets the agent look up anything said earlier in the full log.
shortDescription: A chat agent compacts older turns and searches the full log to recall them.
keyFeatures: Chat Memory v2 with a turn window compaction strategy
Conversation search over the full session log
Small limits so compaction is easy to see in a demo
idealFor: Anyone running long conversations who wants to cap prompt size without losing what was said.
steps: Trigger: a message arrives in the workflow chat.
Answer: the AI Agent answers from its short history and searches the conversation when it needs older turns.
Reply: the answer is sent back to the chat.
